_notes: REPURPOSED as of v3: this file is no longer seed data loaded into the DB. Exercises are now generated dynamically by Gemini and resolved to real media via the WorkoutX exercise API + YouTube Data API (see Phase 7b of the build brief), then cached in a live exercise_catalog DB table. Keep THIS file only as a reference for the controlled vocabulary Gemini must use in its structured output and that the safety blocklist checks against: the session_role values (warmup / main / cooldown), the area values, and the contraindication tag names. The 16 sample entries below are illustrative of the shape/tagging convention, not a literal list to seed — gif_url/video_url on these samples are intentionally null since real ones are now fetched at runtime.

exercises.name: Seated Marching
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall in a chair. Lift one knee up like you're marching, then the other. Keep going slowly.

exercises.name: Chair Sit-to-Stand
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit at the edge of a sturdy chair. Stand up slowly using your legs, then sit back down slowly. Use armrests if needed.
exercises.gif_search_query: sit to stand chair exercise elderly

exercises.name: Wall Push-ups
exercises.instruction_simple: Stand facing a wall, arm's length away. Place palms on wall, bend elbows to bring chest toward wall, then push back.

exercises.name: Seated Front Arm Raise
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall. Raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extensions
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall. Slowly straighten one knee until leg is out in front, hold briefly, then lower. Repeat with other leg.

exercises.name: Standing Heel Raises
exercises.instruction_simple: Stand holding the back of a chair. Rise up onto your toes, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Torso Twist
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall, arms crossed over chest. Gently twist your upper body to one side, return to center, then twist to the other side.

exercises.name: Standing Side Leg Raise
exercises.instruction_simple: Hold the back of a chair. Slowly lift one leg out to the side, then lower. Repeat with the other leg.
exercises.gif_search_query: standing side leg raise exercise seniors

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Rolls
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall. Roll your shoulders up, back, and down in a smooth circle. Then reverse direction.

exercises.name: Seated Ankle Circles
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall, lift one foot slightly off the ground. Rotate your ankle in circles. Switch feet.

exercises.name: Standing March in Place
exercises.instruction_simple: Stand near a chair for support. March in place, lifting your knees comfortably, for about 30 seconds.
exercises.gif_search_query: standing march in place seniors exercise

exercises.name: Seated Knee-to-Chest Stretch
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall. Use both hands to gently pull one knee toward your chest, hold, then release. Repeat with the other leg.
exercises.gif_search_query: seated knee to chest stretch seniors

exercises.name: Standing Single-Leg Balance (Supported)
exercises.instruction_simple: Hold the back of a chair with both hands. Lift one foot slightly off the ground and balance. Switch legs.
exercises.gif_search_query: single leg balance exercise chair support seniors

exercises.name: Seated Neck Stretch
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit tall. Gently tilt your head toward one shoulder, hold, then return to center. Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Seated Wrist and Hand Stretch
exercises.instruction_simple: Extend one arm forward, palm up. Use the other hand to gently pull fingers back. Switch hands.

exercises.name: Deep Breathing Cooldown
exercises.instruction_simple: Sit comfortably. Breathe in slowly through your nose for 4 counts, hold for 2, breathe out for 4. Repeat 5 times.
